description.value: Sakura Sushi & Grocery is a beloved Victoria institution that opened in 1997 and has grown into one of the city's most popular Japanese takeout destinations, offering handmade sushi rolls, hot kitchen dishes like udon, donburi, curry, and bento, as well as Japanese grocery items. The business is now owned by chef Morgan Onda, who brings over 40 years of culinary experience including travels through Japan. It operates takeout-only from its compact downtown location beside the market on Quadra Street.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sakurasushivictoria.com is fully functional and confirms the address (1213 Quadra Street, Victoria, BC V8W 2K6) and phone (250-388-3636). The about page confirms the business is actively operating as a takeout-only Japanese restaurant and grocery; the in-dining experience was permanently closed post-COVID. The website makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cyclist-specific amenities, so those are null. Takeout is confirmed explicitly ('Japanese Take Away' on front page; 'most popular Take-outs in Victoria' on about page). The OSM name 'Sakura Sushi' differs from the website's consistent branding of 'Sakura Sushi & Grocery', which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM name is 'Sakura Sushi' but the business consistently brands itself as 'Sakura Sushi & Grocery' across all website pages and the footer. OSM record should be updated.
In-dining experience is closed (post-COVID decision noted on about page); business is now takeout-only. OSM amenity tag 'restaurant' may be misleading.
OSM phone field is empty; phone number 250-388-3636 was sourced from the website, not OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible takeout restaurant and grocery in downtown Victoria. Website is live with 2025 copyright and confirmed contact details.

Takeout.detail: Website front page: 'for the best Japanese Take Away and Grocery Items in Downtown Victoria.' About page: 'one of the most popular Take-outs in Victoria.' In-dining closed since COVID

wow_evidence: opened in 1997... one of the city's most popular Take-outs in Victoria... chef Morgan Onda... over 40 years of culinary experience
